title: Price Tracker Target Hit Rate
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pricetrack:alert
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(target_hit="true")) as successful by _time store_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for price targets by store.
value: Hit rate tells you whether the target thresholds are realistic or set so low they almost never matter.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for price targets events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for price targets by store.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often price targets works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
